messages:
julia (auditor): Hi — for SOC2 fieldwork we need a timebound 'key witness snapshot' covering ephemeral KMS keys involved in incident INC-2026-04. Need: key metadata (ARN, creation/rotation timestamps), HSM attestation ID, envelope key IDs, and RBAC state for service accounts at 2026-03-15T18:00Z. Can you produce a signed bundle?

ravi (sec-eng): We can. Quick q: do you need raw CloudTrail/SIEM logs included or just KMS metadata + IAM/RBAC diffs?

julia (auditor): Both. CloudTrail for decrypt events + RBAC diffs. Also a chain-of-custody manifest signed with a KMS key would be ideal.

maria (oncall): Plan: 1) export CloudTrail decrypt events for the window 2) export KMS key list + attributes 3) snapshot IAM/ k8s rolebindings + serviceaccount bindings 4) sign manifest with exportsigning key 5) upload presigned S3 bundle. ETA ~4h.

ravi (sec-eng): Note: we'll redact user emails but preserve canonical user IDs and eventIDs. Also need to show HSM attestation proof that key material never left HSM.

julia (auditor): Redaction OK as long as user_id and requestIDs stay intact. HSM attestation required.

kyle (infra): CloudTrail query I'm going to run: ```index=cloudtrail eventName=Decrypt OR eventName=GenerateDataKey | table eventTime, userIdentity.arn, eventName, requestParameters.keyId, requestID, resources```

maria (oncall): Running archival query now. Output format ndjson. Will produce checksums and include sha256 for each file. Signing command we'll use: ```aws kms sign --key-id alias/exportsigning --message fileb://manifest.json --output text --query Signature | base64 --decode > manifest.sig```

ravi (sec-eng): For the RBAC snapshot I'll capture k8s and IAM diffs: ```kubectl get clusterrolebinding --all-namespaces -o json | jq '.items[] | {name: .metadata.name, subjects: .subjects}' > rbac-snapshot.json``` plus current infra git commit hash.

julia (auditor): Also include proof that the ephemeral CMK had non-exportable plaintext (vendor HSM attestation or KMS key policy + usage metrics).

maria (oncall): We have vendor attestation PDF; will include its SHA256 in checksums.txt and the PDF in the bundle. We'll pull CloudWatch metrics for key usage during the window.

kyle (infra): Uploading interim bundle to s3://redwood-audit-temp/7019876543/witness.tar.gz (presigned link DM'ed to @julia).

oncall-bot: upload completed — presigned URL expires in 7 days.

maria (oncall): Package uploaded and DM sent. Bundle contents: cloudtrail-decrypts.ndjson, kms-keys.json, rbac-snapshot.json, manifest.json, manifest.sig, hsm-attestation.pdf, checksums.txt, README.md

julia (auditor): Received the DM. Please add exact command(s) we used to produce manifest.sig and the verification steps (public key / kms alias). Need to be reproducible for auditor verification.

ravi (sec-eng): Added verification steps to README.md. Public alias: alias/exportsigning. Verify example: ```aws kms verify --key-id alias/exportsigning --message fileb://manifest.json --signature fileb://manifest.sig```

maria (oncall): Heads up — found one rolebinding change at 2026-03-15T17:55Z that granted extra role to svc-connector. Included diff and short writeup; marked as "investigate" in bundle.

\jkyle (infra): PR and pipeline evidence attached: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/4823 pipeline run 2026-03-15T18:10Z (artifact included).

julia (auditor): Good — include link to PR and the mitigations timeline in the manifest. This satisfies the initial evidence ask. We'll review and may request deeper forensic pulls if needed. Thanks team :thumbsup:
